prose: Explain to a new engineer, in about 350 words of plain prose with no lists and no code, why a hash table has average constant-time lookup and what makes it degrade.
code: Write a Python function parse_iso_duration(s: str) -> int that converts an ISO-8601 duration such as P1DT2H30M5S into seconds. Include a docstring, raise ValueError on bad input, and add five pytest tests. Output only the code.
